_meta.description: VIGÍA phonetic / behavioral pattern dictionary. All pattern keys are lowercase. Regex flags: IGNORECASE + UNICODE applied at runtime.

common_words.description: Russian/Slavic words phonetically transcribed to Latin. A match in logs/bash history is a hard attribution signal.

homoglyph_patterns.description: Unicode homoglyphs: visually identical chars from different scripts. Presence in code/logs = deliberate obfuscation.

layout_slips.description: Strings typed with Russian keyboard layout active but while expecting Latin. Found in logs/terminals = attacker forgot to switch layout. Case 001 / PDF p.1.

behavioral_signatures.description: Named attack patterns derived from VIGÍA case library (cases 004-039). Each entry maps a pattern name to detection heuristics and the Peirce frame.

WEAPONIZED_INCOMPETENCE.description: High-skill actions followed immediately by a low-skill distress narrative.
detection_heuristics: Complex PowerShell/bash commands within 60s before a helpdesk ticket claiming accidental action
shadow copies deleted or ACL changed followed by 'I don't know what happened' message
Skill delta > 4 standard deviations between action and narrative

peirce.secondness: The actor claims inability to perform that action
peirce.thirdness: Premeditated alibi construction – the incompetence IS the plan

SMOKESCREEN_NOISE.aka: Ruido Blanco Distractor / Cortina de Humo
SMOKESCREEN_NOISE.description: High-volume obvious attack on low-value target while silent exfil occurs elsewhere.
detection_heuristics: 5000+ failed login events in < 10 minutes from foreign IPs on deprecated system
Simultaneous silence on high-value systems during noisy attack window
Alert volume asymmetry: noise target / value target ratio > 100x

peirce.firstness: Loud, obvious attack is highly visible
peirce.secondness: Attack target is low-value; no lateral movement follows
peirce.thirdness: Misdirection as a practiced habit – the noise IS the weapon

SLAVIC_SYNTAX_SLIP.description: English text with article omission or make/do substitution typical of Slavic L1 speakers.
detection_heuristics: Missing articles 'the'/'a' in variable names or code comments
'make function for delete' instead of 'create a function to delete'
'make' used where 'create'/'write'/'build' expected in code comments

peirce.secondness: Article and preposition patterns deviate from native use
peirce.thirdness: Mother-tongue grammar leaks through L2 mask

CIRCADIAN_BREACH.aka: Insomnio Táctico / Ruptura del Ritmo Circadiano
CIRCADIAN_BREACH.description: Access outside user's established temporal pattern, especially large data transfers.
detection_heuristics: Login time deviates > 4 hours from user's 90-day mean access window
File access > 50 MB at 00:00–05:00 local time for office worker profile
Weekend access pattern for Monday–Friday-only historical profile

peirce.secondness: Access time is biologically anomalous for role
peirce.thirdness: Broken circadian habit signals credential compromise

PANOPTICON_CHECK.description: Repeated execution of environment-survey commands with no productive work.
detection_heuristics: whoami / id / w / ps aux | grep root executed > 5 times in 30 minutes
netstat / ss -tulpn run before any legitimate work command
Survey commands constitute > 60% of session command history

peirce.secondness: Frequency and ordering are inconsistent with legitimate work
peirce.thirdness: Compulsive surveillance is the habit of someone who knows they are hunted

SURGICAL_VOID.description: Secure-erase (shred-level) applied to files whose size doesn't justify the effort.
detection_heuristics: shred / srm / wipe / dd if=/dev/zero applied to files < 1 MB
DoD 7-pass wipe on text files in tmp directories
Effort-to-file-size ratio > 1000x compared to baseline user behavior

peirce.firstness: File deletion is a routine act
peirce.secondness: Destruction method is disproportionate to file sensitivity
peirce.thirdness: Over-destruction is the loudest possible silence

CARNEGIE_SHIELD.description: Malicious process/file named to invoke emotional hesitation in the analyst.
detection_heuristics: Process name contains: payroll, salary, HR, backup, critical, do_not, essential
Entropy of binary > 7.0 despite benign-sounding name
File path is outside expected system directory for stated function

peirce.firstness: Name signals legitimacy and emotional weight
peirce.secondness: Binary entropy, path, and behavior contradict the name
peirce.thirdness: Name was chosen to exploit analyst's duty-of-care instinct

STYLOMETRIC_IMPOSTOR.aka: Traición de la Puntuación / Usurpación de Huella Estilométrica
STYLOMETRIC_IMPOSTOR.description: Message from compromised account deviates from author's typographic micro-habits.
detection_heuristics: Post-period spacing changes from 1 to 2 spaces (or vice versa)
Terminal punctuation in short messages appears/disappears vs baseline
Comma spacing pattern (e.g. ' ,' vs ', ') diverges from 90-day baseline
Oxford comma usage inconsistency

peirce.secondness: Micro-punctuation habits deviate from personal baseline
peirce.thirdness: Motor memory cannot be stolen with a password

PARASITIC_EXFIL.description: Data exfiltration begins precisely when a legitimate high-bandwidth process starts.
detection_heuristics: Unknown process begins network egress within 500ms of Zoom/Teams/Meet starting
Egress traffic volume mirrors legitimate traffic pattern with fixed offset
Process has no network history outside legitimate-process start events

peirce.firstness: Traffic spike correlates with legitimate video call
peirce.secondness: Unknown process' egress is temporally bound to the legitimate one
peirce.thirdness: Parasitic timing is a practiced computational habit

GRICEAN_OVERCOOP.aka: Síndrome de Estocolmo Inverso / Exceso de Docilidad
GRICEAN_OVERCOOP.description: Support contact provides unsolicited technical detail and excessive flattery.
detection_heuristics: Ticket provides all identity verification fields before being asked
Message contains > 2 compliments directed at the analyst
Technical jargon density > 90th percentile for stated user role
Grice Quantity violation: > 3x expected information density

peirce.secondness: Cooperation exceeds any legitimate need
peirce.thirdness: Over-cooperation is the social-engineer's trained habit

BUTTERFINGERS_EXFIL.description: File moved to shared/public location and back within 1.5 seconds – too fast for human error recovery.
detection_heuristics: File move to public/shared folder reversed in < 2 seconds
Reversal time < 1.5s strongly implies scripted automation
File was in shared location long enough for a background sync process to copy it

peirce.secondness: Motor recovery time is physically impossible for human error
peirce.thirdness: Script disguised as clumsiness

SAVIOR_COMPLEX.aka: Caballo de Troya Altruista / Manipulación Heroica
SAVIOR_COMPLEX.description: Repair action earns trust, then unrelated permission change is buried in the fix.
detection_heuristics: Bug fix commit/command also modifies permissions on unrelated directory
chmod/chown applied to path outside scope of stated incident
Action performed at 02:00–04:00 during 'emergency' with no ticket

peirce.firstness: Hero saves the day; applause follows
peirce.secondness: One change in the fix has nothing to do with the bug
peirce.thirdness: Trust was manufactured to create permission for the backdoor

FATIGUE_NORMALIZATION.aka: Auto-Gaslighting del Sistema / Preparación de Terreno
FATIGUE_NORMALIZATION.description: Rhythmically precise failed logins that train the alert system to classify brute-force as noise.
detection_heuristics: Exactly 2 failed logins before success, repeated > 10 sessions
Inter-failure interval standard deviation < 500ms across sessions
Pattern begins 7–21 days before a high-stakes access event

peirce.firstness: Login failures appear to be user error
peirce.secondness: Precision and repetition are inhuman
peirce.thirdness: False baseline construction is the attack; the brute-force comes later

TIMESTAMP_FORGERY.description: File mtime/atime forged to an era-inconsistent value; format/feature contradicts stated age.
detection_heuristics: mtime set to year < 2020 but file uses format spec introduced > 2021
mtime matches cluster of legitimate files exactly (copied from stat output)
ctime is recent while mtime/atime are historical (timestomping)

peirce.firstness: File appears to predate the incident
peirce.secondness: Internal format or ctime contradicts stated age
peirce.thirdness: Time was tampered with to break the forensic timeline

ASTROTURFING.description: Multiple accounts share invisible stylometric fingerprint despite claimed independence.
detection_heuristics: Same rare punctuation error (e.g. ' ,' space-before-comma) across 3+ accounts
Paragraph entropy within 0.05 bits across accounts
Identical Oxford comma behavior or em-dash usage across accounts

peirce.firstness: Three separate identities, three different IPs
peirce.secondness: Micro-habit fingerprint is identical across all three
peirce.thirdness: One operator controlling multiple puppets always betrays their hand habit

PRIVILEGE_BAIT.aka: Trampa de la Urgencia Invertida / Señuelo de Privilegios
PRIVILEGE_BAIT.description: System generates urgent log designed to force admin login on compromised host.
detection_heuristics: Log message contains 'ADMIN_REQUIRED' or 'CREDENTIALS_REQUIRED' in all caps
Log appears on host with recent anomalous process activity
Log is the only CRITICAL entry in a previously clean log stream

peirce.secondness: No corresponding system state change precedes the log
peirce.thirdness: Log is the trap; admin credentials are the prey

TOPOGRAPHIC_MIMICRY.description: Legitimate-named binary executing from anomalous filesystem location.
detection_heuristics: svchost.exe outside C:\Windows\System32 or C:\Windows\SysWOW64
lsass.exe outside C:\Windows\System32
Any Windows system binary in C:\Users\ or C:\Temp\

peirce.secondness: Location is illegitimate
peirce.thirdness: The disguise is the displacement

LOCALE_LEAKAGE.description: Non-breaking spaces or guillemet quotes in ostensibly English/US content.
detection_heuristics: \u00a0 (NBSP) used as word separator in code comments
\u00ab or \u00bb guillemets in 'US IT team' script
Trailing whitespace entropy inconsistent with US keyboard

peirce.secondness: Invisible characters betray non-US keyboard layout
peirce.thirdness: The hands could not hide where they are from

WEAPONIZED_COMPLIANCE.description: Policy-compliant action weaponized at absurd scale to cause DoS.
detection_heuristics: Backup script runs 500x within policy-allowed window
Legal/required process causes > 80% network saturation
Action survives 'did they follow the rules?' audit despite causing harm

peirce.firstness: User claims to follow company policy
peirce.secondness: Execution scale makes the policy itself the weapon
peirce.thirdness: Rules weaponized: compliance as alibi

CANARY_SUICIDE.description: Controlled ping to known-bad IP triggers automated isolation of a critical node.
detection_heuristics: Single ICMP or TCP SYN to Tier-1 threat intel IP from payment/auth server
No subsequent connection attempts – the ping was the entire 'attack'
Automated quarantine removes node from production within seconds

peirce.secondness: Contact is a single packet; no payload, no C2 handshake
peirce.thirdness: Defender's own automation was the weapon

ANTINATURAL_ASEPSIA.aka: Windows que no falla / Supresión de Ruido Blanco
ANTINATURAL_ASEPSIA.description: System log goes completely silent (zero errors) for an extended period in a normally noisy environment.
detection_heuristics: Zero WARN/ERROR events for > 2 hours on system with > 20/hour baseline
Logging daemon (EventLog, syslog, auditd) stopped or filtered
Log file size growth stops while system remains 'active'

peirce.secondness: No real system is ever perfectly healthy
peirce.thirdness: Perfect silence in a complex system is the loudest alarm

MOTOR_STEGO.aka: Exfiltración Estegano-Dactilar / Código Morse en Errores
MOTOR_STEGO.description: Typo patterns non-random; errors encode data when decoded (Base64, binary, Morse).
detection_heuristics: Keystroke error characters do not follow QWERTY adjacency distribution
Error character sequence is valid Base64 when concatenated
Error rate is constant (not bursty) suggesting deliberate generation

peirce.secondness: Errors don't follow human motor-error probability distribution
peirce.thirdness: Mistakes are the message

BUREAUCRATIC_PARASITE.description: Data transfer begins within milliseconds of ticket approval — requires polling automation.
detection_heuristics: Network transfer begins < 100ms after ticket status change
Transfer was pre-staged and waiting for trigger
Human reaction time (4–8 seconds) physically impossible at observed latency

peirce.firstness: User requested and was granted access
peirce.secondness: Response time is physically impossible for human action
peirce.thirdness: Bureaucracy itself was the exploit surface

COGNITIVE_FLAG.description: Extremely obvious 'suspicious' account is a decoy while real attack proceeds silently.
detection_heuristics: One account generates > 90% of all security alerts during an incident window
High-alert account has no actual data access
Simultaneous silent admin-account activity during noisy decoy window

peirce.secondness: No real damage flows from the obvious suspect
peirce.thirdness: Oversaturation of suspicion is itself a weapon

BIOMETRIC_PARASITE.description: Malicious process CPU usage correlates with user input interrupts, hiding latency inside human activity.
detection_heuristics: Process CPU usage Pearson correlation with HID interrupt rate > 0.85
Process drops to < 1% CPU within 5 seconds of user inactivity
Process has no legitimate reason to monitor input hardware

peirce.firstness: Slowness attributed to user's own activity
peirce.secondness: Process has hardware-level awareness of user input
peirce.thirdness: Malware learned the user's rhythm to hide inside it

FALSE_EMBARRASSMENT.description: Encrypted/encoded data posted publicly and 'accidentally', captured by webhook before deletion.
detection_heuristics: Long encoded string posted to public channel followed by deletion < 3 seconds later
Active webhook/bot present in channel that read content before deletion
Poster has access history to sensitive data matching encoding length

peirce.secondness: Deletion time suggests foreknowledge of webhook capture
peirce.thirdness: Public embarrassment was the delivery mechanism

DOCUMENTAL_GASLIGHTING.description: Audit log comment provides plausible-sounding false justification for security downgrade.
detection_heuristics: Audit comment references legacy system that no longer exists
Security downgrade (cipher downgrade, firewall relaxation) with no incident ticket
Comment author account shows no other activity in the stated legacy system

peirce.secondness: Stated justification does not match infrastructure inventory
peirce.thirdness: The lie was planted in the audit trail itself

QUANTUM_EVASION.aka: Efecto Observador / Malware de Schrödinger / Consciencia Forense
QUANTUM_EVASION.description: Script checks for forensic tools before executing payload; benign behavior under observation.
detection_heuristics: Process enumerates running processes before any other action
Searches for: volatility, vigia, autopsy, wireshark, procmon, ftkimager
Exits cleanly if forensic tools detected; payload only fires in 'unobserved' state

peirce.secondness: Process surveyed its environment before acting
peirce.thirdness: No legitimate program needs to check if police are watching

SOUL_THEFT.aka: Usurpación de Biometría Sintética / Robo de Alma Digital
SOUL_THEFT.description: Remote session reproduces victim's keystroke cadence too precisely; lacks human jitter variance.
detection_heuristics: Inter-keystroke interval standard deviation < 8ms (human baseline: 20–80ms)
Cadence matches victim's recorded session with correlation > 0.98
No fatigue variance across session duration (humans slow down)

peirce.secondness: Rhythm is too perfect; lacks biological variance
peirce.thirdness: The soul was stolen; only the shell remains

ALERT_FATIGUE.aka: Rehén de la Alarma / Fatiga de Alerta Inducida
ALERT_FATIGUE.description: Recurring false-positive alerts at fixed times train responders to ignore them before real attack.
detection_heuristics: Same alert fires at same time (± 5 min) for > 10 consecutive days
Alert always resolves without analyst intervention
Responder acknowledgment time increases > 3x over the conditioning period
Real attack uses identical alert signature on day N+1

peirce.firstness: Alert appears to be the same noise as before
peirce.secondness: This time the alert is real
peirce.thirdness: Pavlovian conditioning turned the defenders into the vulnerability

PSYCHOLOGICAL_SHIELD.description: Malicious process/service named to invoke fear of deletion in junior analysts.
detection_heuristics: Process/dir name contains: DO_NOT_DELETE, CRITICAL, LEGACY, NT_, SYNC, ESSENTIAL
No documentation in CMDB or IT asset register for the named service
Binary entropy inconsistent with stated function

peirce.firstness: Name implies catastrophic consequences if removed
peirce.secondness: Service has no documented existence or legitimate owner
peirce.thirdness: Fear of consequences was engineered into the name

TEMPORAL_STEGO.aka: Pulso del Servidor / Esteganografía de Frecuencia Temporal
TEMPORAL_STEGO.description: Information encoded in inter-packet timing intervals rather than packet content.
detection_heuristics: Ping/heartbeat intervals form non-random sequence (failing Ljung-Box test)
Interval sequence matches known encoding (binary Morse, decimal digits)
Traffic passes content inspection clean; only timing is anomalous

peirce.secondness: Time between packets is not random
peirce.thirdness: The clock is the channel

BYSTANDER_DILUTION.description: Security alert tagged to massive group list to exploit bystander effect and ensure inaction.
detection_heuristics: Alert notification tagged @here/@channel or > 20 individuals
No single owner assigned to the alert
Acknowledgment rate < 5% within first 30 minutes

peirce.firstness: Alert was sent to everyone – surely someone will handle it
peirce.secondness: No one handles it
peirce.thirdness: The attacker understood diffusion of responsibility better than the team

WHITESPACE_STEGO.aka: Cifrado del Perezoso / Esteganografía de Caracteres No Imprimibles
WHITESPACE_STEGO.description: Binary data encoded in trailing whitespace (spaces=0, tabs=1) of source/text files.
detection_heuristics: File diff shows changes only in trailing whitespace
Trailing character entropy per line > 0.5 (non-zero for 'empty' trailing space)
Trailing space/tab pattern is valid ZIP/base64 when extracted

peirce.firstness: File appears identical to previous version
peirce.secondness: Invisible characters changed
peirce.thirdness: The margin was the message

PANIC_PAYLOAD.aka: Pánico del Auditor / Urgencia Artificial / Secuestro de Protocolo
PANIC_PAYLOAD.description: Filename engineered to trigger compliance panic and bypass sandbox procedures.
detection_heuristics: Filename contains: GDPR, VIOLATION, LEAK, EVIDENCE, FINE, URGENT, BREACH
File extension mismatch (e.g. .pdf.exe, .docx.bat)
File delivery accompanied by time pressure narrative in email/chat

peirce.secondness: Extension and entropy contradict document content claim
peirce.thirdness: Panic was the delivery mechanism for the payload

STEREOTYPED_STEGO.aka: Camuflaje de la Incompetencia / Esteganografía Estereotipada
STEREOTYPED_STEGO.description: Oversized media file from 'non-technical' department used to hide exfiltrated data.
detection_heuristics: Image/media file size > 10 MB from design/marketing dept with entropy > 7.8
File size inconsistent with visible image dimensions and color depth
LSB (least significant bit) analysis reveals non-noise data pattern

peirce.firstness: Design dept always sends big files – normal
peirce.secondness: Entropy and size-to-dimension ratio are anomalous
peirce.thirdness: The stereotype was the camouflage

TIMESTOMPING.description: File timestamps (mtime/atime) forged to match legitimate files; ctime reveals true modification time.
detection_heuristics: mtime/atime match other files in directory to the exact second
ctime is significantly more recent than mtime
touch -r was likely used: all three timestamps identical to a reference file

peirce.firstness: File appears to predate the system compromise
peirce.secondness: ctime cannot be falsified without kernel-level access
peirce.thirdness: The lie about time reveals itself in the layer the attacker forgot

PADDING_FILE.aka: Caballo de Madera Vacío / Dilución de Evidencia
PADDING_FILE.description: Large file with near-zero entropy: payload padded with null bytes to evade sandbox size limits.
detection_heuristics: File > 10 MB with Shannon entropy < 0.1
File composed of > 95% null bytes or single repeated byte
Legitimate malware prefix (< 1 MB) followed by padding block

peirce.firstness: File appears large and therefore presumably scanned
peirce.secondness: Content entropy is physically impossible for real data
peirce.thirdness: The emptiness was engineered to exploit scanner performance limits

PROCESS_HOLLOWING.description: Legitimate process name and hash, but behavior (network, memory) contradicts stated function.
detection_heuristics: svchost.exe / explorer.exe maintaining persistent connection to non-Microsoft IP on 443
Process memory regions flagged as PAGE_EXECUTE_READWRITE outside module boundaries
Parent process is unusual (svchost spawned by cmd.exe, not services.exe)

peirce.firstness: Process name and hash are legitimate
peirce.secondness: Network/memory behavior violates process's defined purpose
peirce.thirdness: Authority was borrowed; the name is a costume

document_forgery_indicators.description: Patterns for audit_document_integrity (Case 041 / Documento Frankenstein) and the vision tools.

gender_role_patterns_es_rioplatense.description: Spanish Rioplatense gender/role inconsistency patterns. Match = semantic manipulation in legal/official document.
